prompt: As of August 1, 2024, which NFL players were both league MVP and Super Bowl MVP in the same season?
answer:
As of August 1, 2024, **seven NFL players** had won both the **AP NFL MVP** and **Super Bowl MVP** in the same season:

| Season | Player | Team | Super Bowl |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1966 | Bart Starr | Green Bay Packers | Super Bowl I |
| 1978 | Terry Bradshaw | Pittsburgh Steelers | Super Bowl XIII |
| 1989 | Joe Montana | San Francisco 49ers | Super Bowl XXIV |
| 1993 | Emmitt Smith | Dallas Cowboys | Super Bowl XXVIII |
| 1994 | Steve Young | San Francisco 49ers | Super Bowl XXIX |
| 1999 | Kurt Warner | St. Louis Rams | Super Bowl XXXIV |
| 2022 | Patrick Mahomes | Kansas City Chiefs | Super Bowl LVII |

Mahomes was the most recent player to accomplish the feat, becoming the first since Warner in 1999.
